Drawback: Cognitive Fade.name: Drawback: Cognitive Fade
Drawback: Cognitive Fade.description:
🌀 Your Quirk taxes your brain.

⚠️ Push it and your thinking slows, then scrambles, then shuts off for a while.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Denki Kaminari (Electrification), Rikido Sato (Sugar Rush).
Drawback: Cognitive Fade.traitNarrativeEffects: Using the Quirk drains the user's focus, memory and judgment. Quirk Strain 60 (50 for an Exceptional Quirk): thoughts slow; the user loses words, forgets small details and misreads parts of a plan. Quirk Strain 80: the drawback is active; the user can follow only simple plans and instinct, slurs or repeats words, and any use beyond light risks hitting the wrong target or forgetting what they meant to do. Quirk Strain 100: the mind shorts out; the user goes blank and dazed, cannot plan, speak clearly or use the Quirk until Strain falls below 60, and needs someone to lead them clear. Ordinary life: the user avoids heavy Quirk practice before exams, meetings or anything that needs a clear head, and friends learn to spot the vacant look. The signs fade as Strain falls back below each threshold. If the character chose Quirkless, this drawback does not apply: they have no Quirk and never gain Quirk Strain.
